contract: DESIGN.md: 학급 과제의 유형과 관리 동선. Paper/ink library palette; teacher tasks primary, management secondary; student writing first; type names plus book marks; long titles wrap, code stays one line; 44px buttons and matching keyboard order.

accessibility.evidence: Classroom visual E2E runs axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA on teacher/student at both widths, checks visible keyboard focus, and tests reduced-motion transitions. Tested fixture states only; not a full assistive-technology audit.

responsive.evidence: Teacher/student long-title fixtures fit 1440px and 390px without document overflow. Class code height stays under60px. Desktop task/management columns and phone roster cards inspected using Ego Browser and local screenshot viewer.

loading.evidence: Delayed ShortStory submission fetch disables file tools; logout cancellation releases the loading state (classroom browser test).

empty.evidence: Teacher without a class/students/tasks can create them; student without device works receives a writing action and submission guidance. Empty type stays a short message.

error.evidence: Assignment list failure shows retry and removes endless loading; retry returns empty list. Student invalid login shows retryable feedback.

partial.evidence: Assignment request failure keeps the successfully loaded class context and management visible while offering assignment retry.

success.evidence: Browser tests cover class/student creation, assignment creation/toggle, submit/resubmit and teacher independent import; saved/submitted feedback remains visible.

permission.evidence: Student new-work/image restrictions, text-only editing and account role gates retain their browser coverage; existing task draft can resume after creation permission changes.

renderedEvidence.observation: Teacher context banner, primary assignments on left, quiet management on right, roster below. Mock fixture data.
Long class title wraps independently; ABC234 code stays on one line; task types and primary action fit phone width.
Student identity and restrained permissions; two formats side by side; readable titles and writing actions.
Single-column student reading/writing flow, distinct book markers, visible heading/status, short action guidance.

limits: API sessions and pictured accounts/passwords are invented local fixtures. No real student data.
Browser viewport emulation is not physical-device or screen-reader proof.
No production deploy or real authenticated classroom verification in this task.
